#### Edit 2: Add a Broadband Inductor at Input
Adding a broadband inductor in parallel with the input capacitor (C4) can help flatten the input impedance across the wideband by providing a low-impedance path at low frequencies and a high-impedance path at high frequencies, improving S11.
